(Charlotte, North Carolina) | college = [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] (2019–2020) | draft_year = 2020 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 4 | draft_team = [[Chicago Bulls]] | career_start = 2020 | years1 = {{nbay|2020|start}}–present | team1 = [[Chicago Bulls]] | highlights = * [[NBA All-Rookie Second Team]] ({{nbay|2020|end}}) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] Sixth Man of The Year ([[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) * ACC All-Freshman Team (2020) }} '''Patrick Lee Williams''' (born August 26, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Chicago Bulls]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. He was the fourth pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]]. ==Early life== Williams was born on August 26, 2001, in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]].{{cite web |last=Wynn |first=Lana |title=Patrick Williams: 4 things to know about the Florida State basketball forward |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/nolesports/2020/01/16/patrick-williams-florida-state-fsu-basketball-forward-facts-stats/4321667002/ |website=Tallahassee Democrat |access-date=December 20, 2020 |date=January 16, 2020}} His parents, Eddie and Janie, played [[college basketball]] at [[Johnson C. Smith University]].{{cite web |title=Patrick Williams player profile |url=https://www.nba.com/player/1630172 |access-date=June 14, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} Williams grew up in Charlotte and attended [[West Charlotte High School]]. He was a four-year starter on the Mighty Lions' varsity basketball team. Williams averaged 20.7 points, 7.7 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 2.8 steals in his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/louisville/Article/Louisville-has-offered-West-Charlotte-High-School-standout-Patrick-Williams-and-are-becoming-serious-with-the-four-star-prospect-117829554/|title=Louisville becoming 'serious' with Charlotte SF Patrick Williams|first=Jody|last=Demling|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=April 28, 2019|access-date=December 20, 2019}} Williams was rated a four-star recruit and a consensus top-50 prospect in his class.{{cite web|url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2018/07/17/louisville-basketball-among-patrick-williams-favorites/786435002/|title=Louisville basketball among the favorites for 4-star Patrick Williams|first=Fletcher|last=Page|work=[[The Courier-Journal]]|date=July 17, 2018|access-date=December 20, 2019}} Williams committed to play college basketball at Florida State over offers from [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]], [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]], [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]], [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]], [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]], [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]], [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] and [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/latest-news/article219606055.html|title=West Charlotte's Patrick Williams, top 40 recruit, picks out of state ACC school|first=Langston|last=Wertz Jr.|work=[[The Charlotte Observer]]|date=October 6, 2019|access-date=December 20, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/Florida-State-has-landed-a-very-talented-wing-in-North-Carolina-native-Patrick-Williams-122933100/|title=Seminoles nab talented wing Patrick Williams|first=Brian|last=Snow|website=247Sports.com|date=October 6, 2019|access-date=December 20, 2019}}{{cite web |last=Biancardi |first=Paul |authorlink=Paul Biancardi |date=October 7, 2018 |title=What ESPN 100 forward Patrick Williams will bring to Florida State |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/insider/story/_/id/24922143 |access-date=December 23, 2019 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}} As a senior in 2019, Williams averaged 22.1 points, 9.0 rebounds, 2.8 blocks and 3.1 assists per game and was named the [[Mecklenburg County, North Carolina|Mecklenburg County]] Player of the Year by ''[[The Charlotte Observer]]'' as he led the Lions to the [[North Carolina High School Athletic Association|North Carolina]] 4A state championship game.{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/high-school/preps-blog/article229025054.html|title=West Charlotte's Patrick Williams headlines Observer's All-Mecklenburg boys basketball team|first=Langston|last=Wertz Jr.|work=The Charlotte Observer|date=April 11, 2019|access-date=December 20, 2019}} Williams played in the 2019 [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/high-school/article229496309.html|title=West Charlotte's Patrick Williams, Cox Mill's Wendell Moore in Jordan game Saturday|first=Langston|last=Wertz Jr.|work=The Charlotte Observer|date=April 19, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} Williams finished his high school career with 1,787 points scored, 749 rebounds and 310 assists over four seasons.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/FSU-Mens-Basketball-freshman-Patrick-Williams-NBA-first-round-talent-ESPN-mock-draft-136083431/|title=Williams projected as first round talent in ESPN NBA mock draft|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=September 24, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} ==College career== Williams entered his freshman year rated as 21st-best prospect for the [[2020 NBA draft]] according to [[ESPN]].{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=November 4, 2019 |title=NBA mock draft: Viewer's guide for our top prospects |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/insider/story/_/id/27998169 |access-date=December 23, 2019 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}} He spent the season as the Seminoles' [[sixth man]].{{cite web |last=Smith |first=Sam |authorlink=Sam Smith (sportswriter) |title=The Bulls select Patrick Williams from Florida State at No. 4 |url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/features/bulls-select-patrick-williams-florida-state-no-4 |website=NBA.com |access-date=December 20, 2020 |date=November 18, 2020}} Williams scored 18 points with four rebounds against [[Western Carolina Catamounts men's basketball|Western Carolina]] followed by a 16-point performance against [[Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball|Tennessee–Chattanooga]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Freshman-Patrick-Williams-comes-up-big-to-lead-Florida-State-Seminoles-Mens-Basketball-to-victory-against-Western-Carolina-138639258/|title=Patrick Williams comes up big to lead FSU to victory against WCU|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=November 15, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://www.jacksonville.com/sports/20191121/devin-vassell-patrick-williams-lead-florida-state-over-chattanooga|title=Devin Vassell, Patrick Williams lead Florida State over Chattanooga|work=[[The Florida Times-Union]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=November 21, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} He scored 14 points and grabbed a career-high nine rebounds in a 65–59 win over [[2019–20 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.wtxl.com/sports/college-sports/fsu/williams-surges-defense-stifles-in-65-59-win-over-unc|title=Williams Surges, Defense Stifles In 65-59 Win Over UNC|website=[[WTXL-TV|WTXL.com]]|date=February 3, 2020|access-date=February 5, 2020}} The following game, he had 14 points in a 99–81 victory over [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami (Florida)]].{{cite news |title=Walker, Williams lead Florida State's 99-81 rout of Miami |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401168526 |access-date=February 9, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 8, 2020}} Williams contributed 17 points and seven rebounds in an 80–77 win over [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] on February 15.{{cite news |title=Williams, Walker carry load as Florida State survives Orange |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401168527 |access-date=February 19, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 15, 2020}} Williams was named to the [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Freshman team and the conference Sixth Man of the Year at the end of the regular season after averaging 9.2 points, 4.0 rebounds and one block per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.tomahawknation.com/2020/3/9/21171381/florida-state-basketball-players-named-to-all-acc-honors|title=Florida State basketball players named to All-ACC honors|first=Perry|last=Kostidakis|website=TomahawkNation.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=March 9, 2020|access-date=March 9, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/fsu/basketball/fsu-basketball-patrick-williams-earns-acc-6th-man-of-the-year-honors-20200309-2020-seminoles|title=FSU Basketball's Patrick Williams Earns ACC 6th Man of the Year Honors|first=David|last=Visser|website=[[Sports Illustrated|SI.com]]|date=March 9, 2020|access-date=March 12, 2020}} After the season, Williams declared for the 2020 NBA draft alongside teammate [[Devin Vassell]].{{cite news |title=FSU freshman Patrick Williams declares for NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/28957719 |access-date=March 27, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=March 27, 2020}} ==Professional career== Williams was selected by the [[Chicago Bulls]] with the fourth overall pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web|first=Andrew|last=Seigman|title=Bulls draft Florida State forward Patrick Williams at No. 4|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/bulls-draft-florida-state-forward-williams-no-4-020323864--nba.html|work=[[Yahoo Sports]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=November 19, 2020|access-date=November 19, 2020}} On November 22, 2020, he signed his rookie scale contract with the Bulls. On December 23, 2020, Williams made his [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] debut, starting and putting up 16 points, four rebounds, one assist, one steal, and one block in a 104–124 loss against the [[Atlanta Hawks]].{{cite web|title=Young scores 37 as Hawks pound Bulls 124-104 in opener|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401267175|website=ESPN.com|date=December 23, 2020|access-date=December 23, 2020}} On May 15, 2021, he scored a season-high 24 points, alongside five rebounds and two steals, in a 91–105 loss to the [[Brooklyn Nets]]. On October 28, 2021, during the Bulls' 103–104 loss to the [[New York Knicks]], Williams suffered a dislocated wrist. The following day, it was announced that he would need surgery, ruling him out for 4 to 6 months.{{cite web|first=Sam|last=Amico|title=Bulls Expected To Lose Patrick Williams For Season|url=https://hoopswire.com/bulls-expected-to-lose-patrick-williams-for-season/|website=HoopsWire.com|date=October 29, 2021|access-date=October 29, 2021}}{{cite web|first=Jasmyn|last=Wimbish|title=Patrick Williams injury: Bulls forward to miss 4-6 months after tearing ligaments in wrist|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/patrick-williams-injury-bulls-forward-to-miss-4-6-months-after-tearing-ligaments-in-wrist/|website=CBSSports.com|date=October 29, 2021|access-date=March 17, 2022}} Williams returned to the court on March 21, 2022, recording seven points and two rebounds in a 113–99 win over the [[Toronto Raptors]]. On April 10, he scored a career-high 35 points, alongside four rebounds and four assists, in a 124–120 win over the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]]. The Bulls qualified for the postseason for the first time since [[2017 NBA playoffs|2017]] and faced the [[Milwaukee Bucks]], the reigning champions, during their first-round series. Williams made his playoff debut on April 17, recording five points, three rebounds and two steals in a 86–93 game 1 loss. The Bulls ended up losing the series in five games.{{cite web|title=Patrick Williams 2021-22 Stats per Game - NBA|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4431687/year/2022|website=ESPN.com|access-date=February 21, 2024}} On July 6, 2024, Williams re-signed with the Bulls for a reported five-year, $90 million contract{{cite web|title=Bulls re-sign Patrick Williams|url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-re-sign-patrick-williams|website=NBA.com|date=July 6, 2024|access-date=July 6, 2024}} On September 30, 2024, Williams had been cleared for training camp after experiencing foot discomfort during the Bull's minicamp.{{cite web |title=Bulls' Patrick Williams: Ready for training camp |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/bulls-patrick-williams-ready-for-training-camp/ |website=CBSSports.com |access-date=30 September 2024 |language=en |date=30 September 2024}}
